page_title: LOR 2-1 NAN | Lorient v Nantes 31/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Sambou Soumano (Lorient) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90+4' The goal by Nantes won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
90+4' The Nantes players halt their celebrations as referee Bastien Dechepy makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

90+3' Goal! Great link up play between Kelvin Amian (Nantes) and Youssef El Arabi gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom right corner. 2:2.
90+1' Nantes enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
90+1' Remy Cabella (Nantes) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
89' 2 - 1 Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) takes a wonderful free kick and curls the ball into the top left corner with an absolutely phenomenal strike!
88' Ali Youssef (Nantes) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastien Dechepy had an easy-decision to make.
87' Remy Cabella (Nantes) sends a cross into the box, but Yvon Mvogo comes off his line to gather the ball.
85' Substitution. Laurent Abergel makes his way off the pitch and Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) comes on as his replacement.
85' The referee cannot ignore such behaviour. Laurent Abergel (Lorient) sees a yellow card and needs to watch himself for the rest of the game.
84' Anthony Lopes (Nantes) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
83' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
82' Dermane Karim (Lorient) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
81' Youssef El Arabi (Nantes) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
78' We are about to witness a substitution. Mathieu Acapandie (Nantes) is replacing Fabien Centonze.
78' Ahmed Kantari has decided to substitute Johann Lepenant and he is replaced by Francis Coquelin (Nantes).
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Youssef El Arabi (Nantes) is coming onto the pitch as Mostafa Mohamed cannot continue after picking up an injury.
76' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

76' Arthur Avom (Lorient) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Lorient have been awarded a corner kick.
74' Olivier Pantaloni prepares a substitution. Bamo Meite is replaced by Nathaniel Adjei (Lorient).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dermane Karim (Lorient) comes onto the pitch for Pablo Pagis.

74' 1 - 1 Goal! Mohamed Kaba plays in Matthis Abline (Nantes), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom right corner 1:1.
73' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes).
72' Arthur Avom (Lorient) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
72' Bastien Dechepy has a clear sight and sees a foul from Matthis Abline (Nantes).
70' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nantes comes to nothing.
69' The corner is swung in but Nantes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
67' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball goes well wide of the right post.
67' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Nantes.
66' Olivier Pantaloni decides to make a substitution. Jean-Victor Makengo will be replaced by Arthur Avom (Lorient).
66' The substitution has been made. Sambou Soumano (Lorient) has replaced Bamba Dieng.
65' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
64' Poor challenge! Pablo Pagis (Lorient) is penalised for tripping and Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle.
61' Ahmed Kantari has decided to make a change. Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) replaces Louis Leroux.
60' Substitution. Ibrahima Sissoko leaves the pitch and is replaced by Mohamed Kaba (Nantes).
60' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the middle of the target, but Yvon Mvogo keeps it out.
58' Dangerous play by Ibrahima Sissoko (Nantes). Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul.
57' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
54' This is a yellow card! Fabien Centonze (Nantes) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
51' Ibrahima Sissoko (Nantes) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
49' Ibrahima Sissoko (Nantes) is penalised for a foul. Bastien Dechepy had a clear view and blows his whistle.
49' Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
48' The Lorient players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' A pass from Pablo Pagis (Lorient) is intercepted by Anthony Lopes and the move breaks down.
45+2' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Neat passing move from Nantes in order to create new attacking opportunities.

41' The corner is aimed towards the penalty spot where it's met by Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes), but his timing is poor and it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
40' Remy Cabella (Nantes) is about to take a corner kick.
38' Matthis Abline (Nantes) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
37' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lorient.
36' Remy Cabella (Nantes) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.
35' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.

32' 1 - 0 Goal! Bamba Dieng (Lorient) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot into the back of the net. Theo Le Bris assisted in the goal. 1:0.
30' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Bamba Dieng (Lorient) was quite harsh and Bastien Dechepy didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
26' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 1:2.
20' Lorient control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
17' Close effort! Matthis Abline (Nantes) takes the resulting free kick from a promising distance, but he sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
16' Bastien Dechepy shows a yellow card to Bamo Meite (Lorient) for his blatant foul.
14' Matthis Abline (Nantes) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
13' A pass from Pablo Pagis (Lorient) is intercepted by Anthony Lopes and the move breaks down.
10' Fabien Centonze (Nantes) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul.
6' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles past the right post. Poor effort.
4' Ibrahima Sissoko (Nantes) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
3' Yvon Mvogo (Lorient) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
1' Lorient are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Lorient will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Bastien Dechepy.
